items.title: Connect GitHub
items.description: OAuth into GitHub. The app only ever asks for repo/PR scopes it needs; the token stays server-side inside the GitHub Integration Service.

items.title: Other integrations
items.description: None required beyond GitHub for the MVP. Skip this step.

items.title: Create a team
items.description: A team can be exactly 1 human + N agent seats — solo developers are first-class, never a minimum team size.

items.title: Invite members
items.description: Invite teammates by email with roles: admin, engineer, viewer, or guest (guests can review agent output but never approve plans or merge).

items.title: Start a meeting
items.description: Open the Meeting Area, discuss the task with the team, optionally invoke the AI participant for research or a summary, then generate and approve an engineering brief.

items.title: Open the guided demo
items.description: Run the whole loop once on the seeded demo repository before connecting a real private repo. See the Guided Demo walkthrough.
